title: Venue logos
slide_intent: Signal the shift from the umbrella identity to individual venues so readers can find the rules for the mark they need.
strategic_value: Giving venue marks their own chapter can help designers apply the identity at the level visitors encounter.
demonstration: A large white Venue logos heading introduces chapter 3 on the same dark green divider used for earlier chapters.
practical_value: Use this divider to locate the six venue identities and their construction and placement rules.
